candidates.hypothesis: A regularized leaf-wise learner captures complementary categorical interactions.
Row-local missingness, response patterns and ordinal opinions improve the same LightGBM configuration.
The same survey features improve v1 CatBoost without changing its hyperparameters.

selection: Development OOF F1 only; coarse 0.15-0.60 threshold grid inherited from v1. Freeze before reused audit. No leaderboard tuning.
blend_policy: Fixed equal weights only: v1 CatBoost + v1 logistic; v1 CatBoost + best eligible new LightGBM; v1 CatBoost + eligible cat_survey.
